nodes.label: Graphify Enforcement PreToolUse Hook
nodes.rationale: PreToolUse hooks intercept Bash grep/find/rg/ripgrep commands and Read/Glob calls on source-like file extensions, injecting a reminder that graphify-out/graph.json exists and must be queried (graphify query/explain/path) before raw grepping or reading, to keep exploration scoped and cheap rather than brute-forcing the codebase.
